sentences.text:
In this appeal both the parties had filed an application for verification of the settlement of agreement/compromise, which was rejected by the trial court,
vide order dated 14.2.2023 on the ground that offence under section 498A is a non compoundable offence.
Learned counsel appearing for the opposite party no. 2 does not dispute the aforesaid facts.

Under these circumstances it is provided that applicant shall appear before the concerned trial court along with the compromise-deed and file an application for verification of the the agreement of settlement/compromise within 15 days from today.

On receiving the said application the Court below shall take steps for verification of the compromise, within 15 days from date of receiving application and compromise, and shall submit compromise verification report before this Court.
The parties on filing a suitable application shall also be given a certified copy of the report.
List this case as fresh on 30.8.2023 before appropriate Court, on which date, the applicant shall file the report of the concerned Court regarding the verification of the compromise.
Till the next date of listing, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicant.
